description.value: Honey Doughnuts & Goodies has been a Deep Cove institution since 1996, celebrated for freshly made doughnuts that have drawn fans including Kate Winslet. Situated in the heart of Deep Cove village — a natural endpoint for cycling routes around Indian Arm and the North Shore — the café serves a full menu of breakfasts, house-made sandwiches on vegan potato bread, homemade soups, and specialty espresso drinks. Owners Ashak and Ashifa Saferali have built a community hub equally loved by locals and visiting tourists.
